```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Payment System for Chemists, Labs, and Patients

  Scenario: Chemists and Labs can log into the system to access Prescriptions
    Given the system is self-contained and no data is shared with third parties
    When a Chemist or Lab accesses the system
    Then they should be prompted to log in
    And upon successful login, they should be able to access the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Patients can log into the system to access Prescriptions
    Given the system is self-contained and no data is shared with third parties
    When a Patient accesses the system
    Then they should be prompted to log in
    And upon successful login, they should be able to access the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Only emails are sent to Patients including the full prescription and Invoice
    Given a Patient has logged into the system
    When the system processes a prescription
    Then an email should be sent to the Patient
    And the email should include the full prescription and Invoice

  Scenario Outline: The system supports an interface with the current standard Payment Gateway
    Given the system is configured to use MySQL
    When a Patient accesses the payment interface
    Then the Payment Gateway interface should be displayed
    And the interface should support <payment_method>
    Examples:
      | payment_method |
      | Debit/Credit Cards |
      | Net banking      |

  Scenario: A button is enabled to securely accept payments via Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking
    Given a Patient is on the payment page
    When they select a payment method
    Then a button should be enabled to securely accept the payment
    And the button should be labeled "Pay Now"

  Scenario: The system uses Django 2.0
    Given the system is deployed
    When the system is checked for the framework version
    Then the system should be using Django 2.0

  Scenario: The system uses MySQL
    Given the system is deployed
    When the system is checked for the database
    Then the system should be using MySQL

  Scenario Outline: The system supports specified browsers
    Given the system is deployed
    When a user accesses the system using <browser>
    Then the system should be fully functional
    Examples:
      | browser        |
      | Google Chrome  |
      | Mozilla Firefox|
      | Safari         |

  Scenario Outline: The system supports specified operating systems
    Given the system is deployed
    When a user accesses the system using <operating_system>
    Then the system should be fully functional
    Examples:
      | operating_system |
      | Windows          |
      | macOS            |
      | Linux            |
```
